passage.text: In this newsletter, meet our student of the month: Nam!
passage.reading: ɪn ðɪs ˈnuːzlɛtər, ˈmiːt aʊr ˈstuːdənt əv ðə ˈmʌnθ: ˈnɑːm!

passage.text: Nam is a second-year student, and she studies English.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ɪz ə ˈsɛkənd ˌjɪr ˈstuːdənt, ənd ʃiː ˈstʌdiz ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ.

passage.text: She often reads in the library after class.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈɔːfən ˈriːdz ɪn ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri ˈæftər ˈklæs.

passage.text: At lunchtime, she eats at the cafeteria with her best friends.
passage.reading: ət ˈlʌntʃtaɪm, ʃiː ˈiːts ət ðə ˌkæfəˈtɪriə wɪð hɜːr ˌbɛst ˈfrɛndz.

passage.text: Nam is a great volleyball player, too.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ɪz ə ˈɡreɪt ˈvɑːlibɔːl ˌpleɪər, ˈtuː.

passage.text: You can see her on sports day!
passage.reading: juː kən ˈsiː hɜːr ɑːn ˈspɔːrts ˌdeɪ!
